title: Lion Rock at golden hour
author: MC Rangers exco
summary: Twenty-eight of us, one very steep staircase and the best view of Kowloon we've had all year.
body:
We met at Wong Tai Sin at half past two, and by three the first group was already complaining about the stairs. Fair. The climb up to Lion Rock is short but it does not let up.

## The summit

We reached the head just as the light turned gold. Kowloon spread out below us, and for a few minutes nobody said anything, which for this club is a record.

Thanks to everyone who came, especially the first-timers who kept up with the front group. See you on the next one.
